Metadata.title: AlimentaIQ · Intelligent Food Distribution Center
Metadata.description: Lot-based inventory, expiry tracking and prioritized distribution so no food gets lost along the way.

NotFound.title: Page not found

hero.title: No food lost between the warehouse and the table.
hero.subtitle: AlimentaIQ organizes your inventory by lot and expiry date, prioritizes the orders that matter most and warns you before waste or shortages happen.

problem.title: A warehouse without priorities loses food and trust.
problem.expiredBody: Older lots stay at the back and are found only when they are no longer usable.
problem.wasteBody: Slow movers close to expiry end up in the bin instead of on a table.
problem.shortagesBody: Pending demand exceeds available stock and nobody notices in time.
problem.lateBody: Urgent orders compete on equal terms with orders that can wait.

solution.title: Distribution decisions that are clear, explainable and on time.
solution.fefoBody: Every outbound movement consumes lots in expiry order (FEFO), automatically.
solution.priorityBody: Urgency, due date and expiry pressure combine into a score you can tune and understand.
solution.alertsBody: Low stock, upcoming expiries, waste risk and shortage risk, computed on the fly.
solution.aiBody: AI summarizes and suggests rescue plans; if it is unavailable, the rules keep working.

closing.title: Your team now has a place to decide better.
closing.body: Sign in with your administrator or operator account.
